name: Goblet squat

phases.name: bottom
phases.cue: Chest up, elbows inside the knees

phases.name: stand
phases.cue: Drive through your heels to stand

formTips: Hold one end of a dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands
Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders, toes turned out a little
Sit straight down between your heels, keeping your chest tall
Let your elbows track inside your knees at the bottom
Drive up through your whole foot until you're standing tall
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbell drift away from the chest
Rounding the back at the bottom
